description: This file contains Redux action creators related to user login functionality in a React/Redux application, including login, logout, validation, and side effects such as navigation and token management.

methods.name: loginChange
methods.description: Action creator to handle changes in login form fields, updating the Redux store with the new value.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to validate login form data, perform login via API call, handle success and error cases, and update application state accordingly.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Action creator to handle user sign out, clearing authentication data, navigating to login page, and removing token from local storage.
